about_the_game:
The Great Axe is a Beat'em up in the style of medieval fantasy.

Once upon a time, the kingdom of Aldran flourished under the wise rule of King Edric the Lightbringer. Golden fields, peaceful villages and impregnable castles were the symbol of his era. But the darkness that had been dormant in the depths of the Forbidden Lands had awakened. The mysterious Lord Veyron, once exiled for his dark deeds, has returned with an army of monsters and traitors to seek revenge and plunge Aldran into chaos. The king had fallen, the castles were in ruins, and the people were on the verge of despair. The prophecy says that only a chosen warrior, led by an ancient force, will be able to bring light back to these lands. And that warrior is you, an unnamed hero whose fate is linked to the legendary axe.

The kingdom is in danger again! Only you can save him!

Defeat hordes of enemies in close combat. Be careful, the enemies have become faster and angrier! The hero's special pride is the ultimate ability. At the moment of its activation, your character turns into an unstoppable storm of steel, chopping down everything in its path. No enemy can resist this whirlwind of destruction, but use it wisely — strength takes time to recover. And in the most difficult moments, a unique weapon comes to the rescue — the legendary axe called "Sparrow". Forged by elven craftsmen and tempered in the blood of dragons, this ancient artifact has a will of its own. This axe comes to the rescue in difficult moments and crushes your enemies. he will help you walk all the way to the end. The atmosphere of the game is imbued with the spirit of the Middle Ages: the clash of swords, shouts of battle and gloomy melodies create the feeling of a real adventure. Will you be able to purge Aldran of darkness and become a legend? Summon an axe and prove that you are worthy of the title of a Great Warrior!

  • Beautiful graphics

  • Dynamic gameplay

  • An easy-to-learn combat system

  • Hordes of enemies

  • Close combat

  • The spirit of the Middle Ages
